select oc.id, oc.order_id, oc.score, oc.content, oc.ai_optimized, oc.reply_content, oc.create_time, oc.status, o.number as orderNumber, COALESCE(u.name, o.user_name) as userName from sky_take_out.order_comment oc left join sky_take_out.orders o on oc.order_id = o.id left join sky_take_out.`user` u on oc.user_id = u.id
order by oc.create_time desc

select oc.id, oc.order_id, oc.score, oc.content, oc.reply_content, oc.create_time from sky_take_out.order_comment oc
order by oc.create_time desc
mapper.update: update sky_take_out.order_comment set reply_content = #{replyContent}, status = 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select d.name as name, count(*) as number from sky_take_out.order_comment c inner join sky_take_out.order_detail d on c.order_id = d.order_id where c.score <= 2 and c.create_time >= #{beginTime} and c.create_time <= #{endTime} and d.name is not null and d.name != '' group by d.name order by number desc limit 5
select content from sky_take_out.order_comment where score <= 2 and create_time >= #{beginTime} and create_time <= #{endTime} and content is not null and content != ''
